title: Grateful Dead Live at Cincinnati Gardens on 1973-12-04
lineage: SBD > Master Reel > DAT > Sony R500 > SEK'D Prodif Plus > Samplitude v7.02 Professional > FLAC16

ai_review.summary: Clear soundboard capture of a short but solid 1973 show, highlighted by a superb China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider transition and a smoking Truckin'‑>Stella Blue jam.
ai_review.review: The recording is a clean sound‑board mix that lets Jerry’s guitar shine and the China Cat Sunflower transition stand out. Although only the first set (about 11–12 songs) is present, the performance is solid with notable moments like Truckin' into Stella Blue and the GDTRFB > Casey Jones sequence, making it a worthwhile listen despite its brevity.

ai_rating.rationale: Reviews range from 0 to 5 stars; most praise the musical moments and sound quality, but several note the incomplete set and occasional miscues, leading to a moderate‑high overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Listeners repeatedly mention clear Jerry and generally good sound; no major dropouts or muddiness reported.

standout_songs: China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider
show_quality.setlist_flow: Only the first set is captured (11‑12 songs), making the show feel short and incomplete, but the flow within that set is solid.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Clear, nice tone noted by reviewers; guitar sits prominently in the mix.
band_member_comments.Phil: Mentioned Phil addressing the crowd with a glass of wine and complaints about promoters; no specific musical commentary.
